curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42004-1-1.pdf (book 1 builds the backhoe loader; book 2, 42004-1-2.pdf, is the alternate wheel loader)

functions.does: The knob on the cab roof steers: its vertical shaft drives a 20-tooth gear that turns the turntable between the front and rear halves, so the machine bends in the middle (articulated steering).
functions.source: book: steps 3-5, 11-13 and 18 (the circled knob with the turning arrow); function page 71

functions.does: Turning the exhaust stack raises and lowers the loader arm: the stack is the top of a vertical shaft with a worm at its foot, which turns an 8-tooth gear on the loader arm's pivot axle.
functions.source: book: steps 1-5 of the exhaust sub-build, step 42 (the arm's arrow); function page 71

functions.does: The black gear on the side of the loader arm's front tilts the loader bucket: it turns a pair of short cranks that push the bucket round its hinge through two half-beam links.
functions.source: book: loader arm sub-build pages 59-62, steps 42-44 (the arrow in step 44); function page 71

functions.does: The knob on top of the backhoe's upright shaft raises and lowers the backhoe boom: a worm at the shaft's foot turns an 8-tooth gear on the boom's pivot.
functions.source: book: backhoe sub-build steps 1-8 (the turning arrows in step 8); function page 71

functions.does: The black gear at the top of the boom swings the backhoe's stick (dipper) in and out; it is a handle on the stick's pivot axle.
functions.source: book: backhoe sub-build steps 12-13 (the arrow on the stick in step 12, the gear added in step 13); function page 71

functions.does: The backhoe bucket hangs on a click hinge at the end of the stick and is set by hand.
functions.source: book: step 14 of the backhoe sub-build; function page 71 (arrow at the bucket)
functions.note: a click hinge: it holds its angle by friction

functions.does: The steering wheel in the cab turns on its pin; it isn't connected to anything.
functions.source: inferred: it sits on a single axle pin in the seat sub-build
